commentaire: Compatibility zone of this repository for DSH. The compatibility tester (the first step of every install/upgrade) refuses any jump outside it unless --force. The plugin's version is the short git hash (no internal semver). Versions compare segment by segment (0.1.10 is later than 0.1.7). Only min and max are read by the gate; `testees` records what was actually played.
note: 0.2.1-rc.2 (npm `latest` since 2026-10-17; alpha.5 and rc.1 were skipped) VALIDATED on 2026-10-19 on an isolated instance only (own HOME, DSH_HOME and npm prefix: the real engine, profile and port 3080 were not touched): engine tree installed with the robot manifest, profile pins moved to rc.2 by the robot alignment, the same 86 packages as alpha.4 and no patch to re-apply. Boot: the same single known line as alpha.4 (`codex ... already registered`), provided the four hand-made links node_modules/dsh-subagent-{opencode,gemini,qwen,hermes} (the maison providers, outside the profile manifest) are in place: a pnpm run that purges node_modules removes them and DSH then reports 5 entries not activated (seen once, because the sandbox pnpm store differs from the real one; the real profile keeps them). Doctor: 5/11 contracts as before. Live checks replayed: footer 261, auto 17, cards 13, changes 76, animations 8; account-menu has the same 3 failures on alpha.4 and rc.2 (not caused by rc.2). NOT replayed on rc.2: language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills; the real machine is still on alpha.4 (moving it interrupts the sessions running in DSH, so it waits for the owner). 0.2.1-alpha.4 (the `alpha` dist-tag; alpha.3 was skipped) ADOPTED on 2026-10-15 at the owner's request: installed on the real machine by `dsh-lifecycle upgrade 0.2.1-alpha.4 --force` (photo ~/.dsh/lifecycle/photos/20261015144744 kept: `dsh-lifecycle rollback` restores alpha.2), the robot's own boot check passed with the same two lines as alpha.2 (`1 entry did not activate`, `codex ... already registered`), and the real `dsh web` was restarted on it and smoke-tested in the GUI (new-chat page, pinned rows, session icons, source chips, plugin routes 200). Replayed since, the same day, on an isolated instance (own HOME and DSH_HOME, profile cloned from the real one, engine tree 0.2.1-alpha.4, every bundle of this checkout): the sidebar footer, scripts/check-footer-live.mjs (the one-button footer, both menus, the links, the Upgrade dialog and each refusal of Subscribe, the guard on DSH's account launcher: 95 checks), and the instance booted with all bundles mounted. What it found: the trigger of the settings seat is DSH's ACCOUNT launcher (slot `settings.launcher`), whose click opens an account popover (Settings / Feedback / Sign in), not the Settings dialog, so every plugin that clicked it to reach Settings opened that popover; the launcher's code is the same on 0.2.1-alpha.2 (diffed, not replayed there), so the defect is probably older than alpha.4. Fixed in the core plugin (the `window.__kbOpenDshSettings` seam and a capture-phase guard on the launcher) and in the footer (its one button opens our menu). Still NOT replayed on alpha.4: the live checks (language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills) and the surface audit beyond the doctor's. The previous note follows. 0.2.1-alpha.2 prepared on 2026-10-11 and ADOPTED by the owner on 2026-10-12, on purpose although `latest` is still rc.2 and this is an alpha: the machine's `dsh` (/opt/homebrew/bin/dsh, a link into ~/.dsh/kybernos/moteur/0.2.1-alpha.2) and the web profile's packages are on it, and the real `dsh web` runs on it. Played on an isolated instance (own HOME and DSH_HOME, engine tree installed with the robot's own manifest, profile pins moved to alpha.2): the surface audit finds 0 break among its 11 probes (same as rc.2); the instance boots after TWO edits to the PROFILE, not to this repository: (1) the `tools` entry sets `mode: both`, which alpha.2 no longer accepts (`native` | `ptc` only; `ptc` collapses the native tools into run_code), so DSH stops with « 1 required plugin did not activate » until it is set to `native` (the `both` of 2026-09-17 was a workaround for the glm-5.3-flash route, which encodes untyped object parameters as strings: to re-measure); (2) `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector` is no longer a bundle (its profile part is `dsh-experimental-inspector-profile`) and the native tool `subagent_claude_code` now collides with the `kybernos-workers-claude-code` entry, which no longer activates. 10 live checks replayed against the same checks on rc.2 gave the same result (8 OK; the 2 others fail identically on rc.2). NOT played in that first run: language, calls, motion, theme, onboarding, team, skills. Played on alpha.2 since, on isolated instances (2026-10-12): the theme boot sheet, the account's custom instructions, the Auto chat fallback (also played on rc.2) and the phone layout (kybernos-mobile). Still NOT played: language, calls, motion, onboarding, team, skills. 279 of 281 engine packages changed (chat and conversation UI, subagent, session controller, theme), 8 removed (Claude Code and Codex hook bridges, webhook runtime, invariants, schedule bundle), 11 added (persistent terminal, session search and query, session titles, worktree and working-directory tools, schedule tools, translator, inspector). Profile edit (1) is in the real profile (`mode: DSH_TOOLS_MODE || 'native'`); edit (2) was not re-checked there. The rest of the live checks is still to do. 0.2.0-rc.2 validated on 2026-09-26. Installation: package @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with the override « dsh-client-ui-settings-account: 0.2.0-rc.1 » (never published); the 15 profile packages moved to 0.2.0-rc.2 by pnpm. The three retouches were re-applied then (queue-move by a three-way merge with zero conflict on six files, 56/56 assertions; workspace-pins, whose anchors all land; goal-affichage, one adapted anchor) and have since moved into the plugins (patches.json). 0.2.0 traps: reopening a session restores the LAST active tab (Chat/Workflows/workflows-v2), so check-goal-affichage forces the Chat tab; a page left open serves the old module graph: reload before any UI proof. History: 0.1.7-rc.2 validated 2026-09-26; 0.1.7-alpha.1 validated 2026-09-22 (the « broken boot » of the day was a profile left on 0.1.6). General traps: the agent-team-web-profile package is stopped (alignment queries the registry); retouches are per version, and « absent » in a retouch check means an anchor to place, not a failure.
